$comment: HEAPY Edge driver contract v1. A driver is a separate program. The core starts it and talks to it with one JSON object per line on stdin (requests) and stdout (replies and events). stderr is logged. Drivers never write to BAS devices.

args.targets: optional driver-specific list (BACnet: instance ranges, networks)
args.rate: max requests per second on the network
max requests per second to this device
max requests per second to this device

events.cov: Sample, sent whenever a subscribed value changes

event.id: integer or null (null = not tied to a request)

Device.key: stable id, scheme://id, e.g. bacnet://1201 (BACnet device instance)
Device.route: how to reach it now, e.g. 10.77.0.11 or 2001:5 (network:MAC); may change, key does not
Device.name: string

Point.name: string (BAS object name)
Point.states: optional list of state names (binary: [inactive, active]; multistate: 1..n)
Point.cov: boolean, device says the object supports change of value

Sample.error: optional string when v is null

point_address.rule: scheme://device-id/object[?options]. The scheme names the driver. Keys never contain the network route, so a device that moves to a new IP keeps its history.
